summary: Independent re-review of the PNA LWAC O-glycopeptide subset found no blocker or important issues. Dissociation is repeated HCD (beam-type CID) + ETD; 16 RAW files match PRIDE glyco stems; TMT6plex channel-to-dose/genotype map matches DataS1 and SEARCH ratios.

reviewer_context.context: fresh hook agent without producer transcript

spec_compliance.evidence: Active templates independently derived as ms-proteomics + human + cell-lines (v1.1.0). parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human -t cell-lines --use_ols_cache_only exited 0 with only a warning on enrichment wording. 96 rows = 16 RAW × TMT6plex; duplicate comment[dissociation method] and modification-parameter columns are structurally accepted by the validator.

ontology_integrity.evidence: sdrf-tools check --offline: CLEAN (0 hallucinated / label mismatch / wrong ontology / UNIMOD swaps). Controlled NT/AC values for instrument (MS:1002416 Orbitrap Fusion), dissociation (MS:1000422 + MS:1000598), DDA (PRIDE:0000627), trypsin (MS:1001251), hpHRP (PRIDE:0000564), UNIMOD 4/737/35/43, and Cellosaurus CVCL_0045 (HEK293; kidney; female in cl-annotations-db.tsv) resolve. Online OLS check blocked by network reset; offline + parse_sdrf cache used.

source_evidence.evidence: Asserted scratchpad/PXD010155/files.json and pride.json projectAccessions/accession = PXD010155. PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: dox dose series T2 0/4/8/12/16 and T11 0/2.5/5/7.5/10 ng/mL; HEK WT at 0; TMT6plex; PNA LWAC; high-pH RP; Orbitrap Fusion with sequential HCD-MS2 and ETD-MS2. dataProcessingProtocol: 6 ppm / 20 mmu; Carbamidomethyl fixed; Oxidation + HexNAc(S/T/Y) variable for ETD. Independent SEARCH↔DataS1 ratio match favors mono channel order (strict linear hits 1240/2000 T11, 1300/2000 T2; permutations far worse).

file_mapping.evidence: All 16 comment[data file] values are the PXD010155 PNA_2h_ETD_HCD High_pH RAW set (8 T2 + 8 T11); none of the 16 FT_Proteome RAW files appear. Fraction identifiers 1–8 match filename suffixes with 0 mismatches.

design_consistency.evidence: 12 sources (5 HEKindT2 doses + HEK WT in T2 plex; 5 HEKindT11 doses + HEK WT in T11 plex) × 8 fractions × matching TMT channel = 96 assays; unique assay names; labels TMT126–131. Channel map: 126=0 ng uninduced isoform line; 127–130 increasing dox; 131=HEK WT — consistent across all fractions and supported by DataS1 + SEARCH.

omission_safety.evidence: No fabricated RAW stems or proteome FT files. Instrument follows protocol/filenames (Orbitrap Fusion) rather than the incorrect PRIDE instruments CV (LTQ Orbitrap). Engineered HEKindT2/T11 absent from Cellosaurus; parental CVCL_0045 disclosed in evidence limitations. Values do not over-claim beyond PNA LWAC glyco subset. Evidence manifest claim text saying '32 RAW' is wrong for this subset but the SDRF itself correctly lists 16.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf exit 0 (enrichment warning only); sdrf-tools check --offline exit 0 CLEAN; sdrf-tools score exit 0 (93/100). Online sdrf-tools check could not complete (OLS ConnectionResetError).
